caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden ark with a reddish-brown, gabled roof and cream-colored walls, featuring a series of red-framed windows with black dots and a blue horizontal stripe running along the center. The ark sits on a dark, flat base, with a yellow bird perched at the front left corner. In front of the ark, there are fourteen stylized wooden animal figures in different colors, including various shades of brown, gray, yellow, black, and reddish-orange. The animals are arranged loosely in front of the ark, and include several types such as horses, goats, dogs, a camel, a pig, and donkeys. The background is plain and off-white, and the overall arrangement is centered, with all objects clearly visible and spaced apart from one another.
title: Noah's Ark and Animals
